{{Quote|Hurry up, purge the drives.|The scientist, to his associate|<ref name="Chapter 12" />}}
A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] '''scientist''' worked with a [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|remnant]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] led by [[Moff]] [[Gideon]], operating at a laboratory in the [[planet]] [[Nevarro]]'s [[Nevarro Imperial base|Imperial base]]. When a group of individuals [[Second skirmish on Nevarro|infiltrated]] the base, the scientist and his associate attempted to purge the laboratory's data drives before the infiltrators interrupted them. The scientist attempted to fend them off but was [[Death|killed]] along with his associate.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Pardon me.|A Mythrol infiltrator pushes aside the scientist's body|<ref name="Chapter 12" />}}
[[File:ScientistsFightBack-TMCh12.png|thumb|left|300px|The scientists are attacked by Din Djarin and his cohorts.]]
During the [[New Republic Era|reign]] of the [[New Republic]], the scientist worked with a [[Galactic Empire]] [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|remnant]] led by [[Moff]] [[Gideon]]. At an [[Nevarro Imperial base|Imperial base]] on the [[planet]] [[Nevarro]], he and an associate were involved in [[Doctor|Dr.]] [[Penn Pershing]]'s biological experiments at a laboratory where [[blood]] with high [[Midi-chlorian|M-count]] was transfused into individuals, resulting in "catastrophic failure."<ref name="Chapter 12" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> a group of individuals, led by Nevarro's [[Magistrate]] [[Greef Karga]], [[Second skirmish on Nevarro|infiltrated]] the base to destroy it.<ref name="Chapter 12" />

As a precaution, the scientist and his associate attempted to purged the data drives at the laboratory. The infiltrators then arrived, and the scientist ordered his associate to destroy the console while he fired at the Karga and his allies with an [[SE-14r light repeating blaster]]. The infiltrators returned fire, and the scientist was shot, slumping [[Death|dead]] over the console shortly before his associate was also killed. Karga and his accomplices then inspected the experimentation area, and a [[Mythrol]] [[The Fledgling Mythrol|infiltrator]] pushed aside the scientist's body to inspect the console.<ref name="Chapter 12" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Destroy it!|The scientist, to his associate|<ref name="Chapter 12" />}}
The scientist was a [[human]] male with [[Color|light]] skin and dark, graying [[hair]]. When his base was under threat from infiltrators, he and his associate worked to purge all of the information in the laboratory, the scientist urging the associate to destroy the console when the infiltrators found them.<ref name="Chapter 12" />

==Equipment==
The scientist wore the standard white and gray Imperial development project [[Imperial military uniforms|uniform]], with a silver buckled belt and a holster carrying an SE-14r [[light repeating blaster]]. Below his right shoulder was a symbol<ref name="Chapter 12" /> also worn by [[Clone trooper|clones]] in training on the [[planet]] [[Kamino]] before and during the [[Clone Wars]].<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref><ref name="CC">{{TCW|Clone Cadets}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The scientist first appeared in "[[Chapter 12: The Siege]]" of [[Jon Favreau]]'s [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', which was directed by [[Carl Weathers]]<ref name="Chapter 12" /> and released on [[November 20]], [[2020]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-november-2020|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in November 2020}}</ref> Credited as "Imperial scientist" in the subtitles, he was played by an uncredited extra.<ref name="Chapter 12" />
